method: The county clerk e-mailed, on 2026-10-28, a report listing each election precinct and the commission district it votes in (kept out of this repository; its SHA-256 is reportSha256), and answered two questions about it the same day. Each of the county's 2463 Census 2020 blocks is put in the district of the 2020 voting district holding most of it. The report puts I E Cuivre, Farber, Laddonia, Martinsburg, Benton City, South Fork, Mexico 2 and Mexico 4 whole in the Eastern District, and Friendship, Thompson, Wilson/Salt River, Mexico 1, Mexico 5 and Mexico 6 whole in the Western. It splits two. In Mexico 3 the clerk wrote that Jefferson Street is the line, east side Eastern and west side Western; the line is drawn along the Census Bureau's N and S Jefferson St and S Jefferson Rd, carried straight south from the road's end to the edge of the precinct, and a block crossing it goes to the side holding most of it (one block, 7 people). In Community the clerk wrote that Salt River Township is Western and Prairie Township Eastern with Route ZZ the line; the only block of the 2020 Community voting district lying east of Route ZZ and west of the township line, 290079502001089 (12 people), is put in the Eastern District and the rest of Community in the Western. Which side of Route ZZ that block is on was read from where the road runs, not from the clerk.
